NHBS surveyed 1,608 transgender women in seven U.S. urban areas using respondent-driven sampling.
Initiated in 2003, NHBS conducts biobehavioral surveillance among persons at high risk for HIV infection.

methods_quotes.q: Adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) and 95% CIs for prevention and treatment outcomes, by self-reported HIV status, were estimated using log-linked Poisson regression models
with generalized estimating equations clustered on recruitment chain and urban area; models were adjusted for age, race and ethnicity, and urban area.
